About Us

Ownership & Operations

Fisherman’s Processing was established in 2009 to meet the growing needs of the San Diego sportfishing fleet and complement the RSW (Refrigerated Salt Water) methods utilized to maintain the prized catch. Our ownership team features iconic names in long range sport fishing and fish processing. Tim Ekstrom, Randy Toussaint, Brian Sims, Roy Rose, and Raymond Falante combine their knowledge and customer centric focus to ensure that Fisherman’s Processing clients conclude their voyage with a premier processing experience.

Directing operations at the facility are Merrilee Ekstrom and Raymond Falante. Dedicated to best serving our customers Merrilee, Ray, and our team of enthusiastic professionals are focused on efficiently providing a full suite of custom processing options for your catch. Long-range anglers, private boaters, tourists visiting San Diego, every angler taking short trips, fishing the rocks & docks are valued along with their catch. We create a personal connection with every customer wanting their catch professionally filleted.

Our shop is located at 4004 Taylor Street. Conveniently, adjacent to the Old Town San Diego entrance, close to San Diego International Airport and freeway access. We are open every day from 8am – 2pm. The shop offers a variety of items including FP gourmet poke mix and poke sauce, spices, rubs, brine, beer batter, panko breadcrumbs, smoked & flavored finishing salts, Palo Alto Fire Fighters pepper sauce, Anza fillet knives, Grunden’s gear, and Fisherman’s Processing logo wear. Appointments are available outside these hours of operation. Contact us at (619) 255-3128 & (619) 642-7145 or email redacted@example.invalid

Reservations

Reservations with Fisherman’s Processing

Make a reservation today! We will schedule to meet every reservation at Dana Landing, Fisherman’s Landing, H & M Landing, Point Loma Sportfishing, Seaforth Landing, and our shop. Our goal is to process your fish in the timely manner you expect. Customers may request same-day service including table-ready fillets, trade for cans, jerky, or smoked fillets; next-day fresh or frozen table-ready fillets; and/or later pick-up frozen table-ready product.

Our online reservation system captures every reservation in the order received and prioritizes the sequence of service based on this timing as well as customer request. We require a $100 deposit for all reservations. This deposit is applied to fees incurred upon the completion of the customer’s order. Deposits are fully refundable if you do not catch fish and if cancelled prior to the trip departure. The deposit is forfeited if you choose to utilize another processor. If you choose to pay with a credit card there is a 3% (non-refundable fee) added to your transaction.
